[Section] Methodology ::: GlossBERT ::: GlossBERT(Sent-CLS-WS)
[source_id=33] We use context-gloss pairs with weak supervision as input. We take the final hidden state of the first token [CLS] and add a classification layer ($label\in \lbrace yes, no\rbrace $), which weekly highlight the target word by the weak supervision.
